fraud:account_takeover.definition: two purchases from a new device in a new country within an hour of a home-country purchase, after a session with credential + payout changes and a failed second factor

fraud:burst.definition: 8-12 purchases three minutes apart on an account that normally transacts every few days

fraud:graph_linked.definition: three 17-day-old accounts on one device and one payout bank account, five purchases each at high-risk merchants, then transfers in a circle

fraud:structuring.definition: four transfers just under the reporting threshold within a week

fraud:dormant_activation.definition: 120 days of silence then six purchases in two days

exposure:merchant_abuse.definition: purchases at a merchant with an injected 30% dispute ratio; the transactions themselves are not fraud

legit:high_value.definition: a genuine purchase above the auto-approval limit on a home device; policy must route it to a human, not block it

stages.screening: transaction-level risk band on every transaction (transaction_level)
stages.decisioning: policy outcome of the full pipeline on a sample (policy_sample)
stages.investigation_triage: account-level monitoring over the account's activity (account_level)

burst_by_position.definition: velocity-visible = at least 3 earlier transactions on the account in the 10 minutes before (the rapid-fire rule's input)

merchant_level.definition: abused (scenario) or shell registration or >= 2 prior flags

methodology.kind: synthetic (labelled generator scenarios); empirical on that generator
methodology.dataset: seeded synthetic world; development seed plus two held-out seeds
methodology.method: transaction-level risk band on every transaction, monitoring on every account, merchant profiles; positive = HIGH or CRITICAL; labels come from the generator and are read only here
methodology.limitations: point values were tuned on the development seed; scenarios mirror the rules they are meant to trip; not real payment data
